scope: regular multi-channel signal; no silent interpolation
warning: Nyquist cannot prove absence of acquisition aliasing. Analog band is a declaration. Offline processing uses future samples; online mode has causal-only transforms, not a streaming deployment.

capture.config_scope: full regular signal schema, preprocessing and explicit recording/block window split
capture.data_access_time: captured before scheduling; run.data_access_at records first immutable snapshot read boundary

provenance.scope: whole recording isolated transforms; split before windows; available_at endpoint; no source edits
provenance.seed_reason: deterministic LBFGS initialization/spectra; seed retained in recipe, no sampling

recordings.window_policy: complete windows only; incomplete trailing samples retained in source, not feature windows

resample.lineage: all source recording rows conservative FIR dependency; nominal times are derived

preview.scope: uniform index visual preview only; calculations use all selected samples
preview.source_identity: derived sample ids if resampled; full source recording RowIds retained

stft.scaling: one-sided PSD, linear power/unit²/Hz; no dB clipping
stft.complex_normalization: SciPy psd sqrt(fs sum(window²)); positive interior power×2
